from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class TransferStatistic(BaseModel):
    """Transfer admission statistics for one institution from one document."""
    institution_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the institution as reported in the document")
    transfer_applicants: int | None = Field(description="Total number of degree-seeking transfer applicants")
    transfer_admitted: int | None = Field(description="Total number of admitted transfer students")
    academic_period: str | None = Field(description="The academic period this data covers, in YYYY-MM format")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    transfer_statistics: list[TransferStatistic]
